frameIndex: row * columns + column  (row = state: 0 default, 1 visited, 2 locked; column = order)

notes.shape: diamond node: glowing ink rim S5 + inner halo S4 + outer shade S2, dark leather fill S1; symbol S5 + 4-neighbour halo S4
notes.journey: winding dotted road + signpost (평화지역 → 잔 여정 노드)
notes.accent: one accent point per icon (slots 20-22, drawn with floor-1 ramp; UI swaps to current floor ramp like other UI kit files)
notes.visited: cooled: rim and symbol S4, no glow, no accent
notes.locked: no fill (page shows through), broken rim S2 + symbol S2 = faint pressed mark

palette: parts/art/palette/lopad.json (ui.ramp sepia S0-S5 fixed, UI only + floor accent slots 20-22 runtime swap)
